name: Assertion-Evidence
tagline: Warm off-white page, serif sentence headlines, range-frame line and bar charts with one brick-red accent (extended from a single-slide specimen)

palette.description: Warm paper white, near-black ink, one brick-red accent for the trend and key number.

typography.style: Full-sentence serif headline above a single figure with direct labels and thin range-frame axes.

best_for: Talks where every slide makes one claim and shows one figure that proves it. Fits research results, data stories and analytical briefings.
avoid_for: Decorative or emotional brand storytelling that needs imagery.
